objective: Increase expected Material/PBR and Texture/Microdetail quality rather than adding further evidence-only plumbing: replace scalar-only facade detail fallback response with deterministic lighting-neutral manufacture-scale normal and metallic/smoothness microstructure, while keeping actual-pixel scoring fail-closed.

changes.summary: Adds deterministic 1024x1024 tangent-space normal plus Standard metallic/smoothness source-map generation for anodized aluminum, galvanized steel, EPDM, aged AC plastic, pipe insulation wrap and PVC drain hose. Data maps are linear, repeat/trilinear/mipped, anisotropy 16, CompressedHQ; no albedo lighting or weathering is baked. Generated canonical materials remain opaque, non-emissive and use map R=metallic / A=smoothness with GlossMapScale=1.

Adds fail-closed formal 3840x2160 pre-cull validation of the microstructure contract, canonical generated asset binding/importer state and native-4K review requirements; mapped BRDF ranges remain independently enforced by the existing registered-material physicality guard.

Machine-readable physical/material and evidence contract including manufacture intent, numeric metallic/roughness ranges, anti-alias sampling, canonical 100% crops, explicit limitations and zero awarded Visual Fidelity points.
Lookdev illustration for front-fill versus grazing-light intent, material-specific microstructure and required native-4K review questions. Explicitly marked as a diagram rather than render evidence.

manufactureAndMaterialReasoning.anodized_aluminum: Fine extrusion-scale relief; aged anodized surface remains metallic per project registry but rough enough to avoid chrome response. Direction/orientation must be confirmed in the sash-rail grazing crop because procedural primitive UV axes are not yet metric-orientation proof.
manufactureAndMaterialReasoning.galvanized_steel: Broad zinc-like mottling without glitter pixels; high metallic response with oxidation-broadened roughness.
manufactureAndMaterialReasoning.epdm_rubber: Fine matte elastomer grain, metallic=0; grazing edge response must come from lighting/Fresnel rather than painted rims.
manufactureAndMaterialReasoning.aged_abs_ac: Fine mould orange peel, metallic=0; oxidation/chalking remains a separate aging/albedo concern.
manufactureAndMaterialReasoning.pipe_insulation_cover: Shallow wrap seam plus skin microrelief; macro bends/collars remain geometry.
manufactureAndMaterialReasoning.pvc_drain_hose: Shallow circumferential ribbing plus polymer grain; routing and silhouette remain geometry.

selfAudit: The first generator validator incorrectly required ignored fallback _Metallic/_Glossiness scalars to stay inside the mapped registry range. The legacy detail builder rewrites those scalar fallbacks after bootstrap even while _METALLICGLOSSMAP remains authoritative. Validation was corrected to require fallback scalars only to remain finite normalized values; mapped source R/A ranges remain the formal BRDF contract and are independently checked by QualityBlockRegisteredMaterialAssetPhysicalityQA.

The initial microstructure contract used a non-canonical repetition risk alias. The canonical visual gate ID is obvious_repetition; both the contract and C# exact-set guard were corrected before this run record.

Exact millimetre-scale texture density and extrusion/corrugation orientation are not claimed because the fallback primitives use normalized procedural UVs. Existing texel-density QA plus real 100% crops remain authoritative.

One canonical material is reused across repeated assemblies. High-frequency microstructure is intentionally subtle, but repeated phase/synchronization is not declared safe until rendered repetition diagnostics and human native-4K review pass.

No generated PNG or MAT asset is committed by this source-only run. They are authored deterministically inside Unity on script reload and must be observed/imported on the real Editor/Runner before being treated as runtime assets.

expectedVisualScoreImpactNotAwarded: Material/PBR physical plausibility: positive potential from map-driven roughness/metallic variation and non-emissive lighting-neutral microrelief, especially anodized aluminum and galvanized hardware.
Texture/microdetail/texel fidelity: positive potential from material-specific normal microstructure at 1024 source resolution with mip/trilinear/aniso filtering.
Temporal/LOD/aliasing stability: neutral-to-positive intent only; fine normal structure could still shimmer or moire and therefore must be tested rather than assumed.
Critical defects: source design reduces baked_or_painted_highlights and impossible_material_physics risk, but obvious_repetition and severe_aliasing_or_shimmer remain actual-pixel decisions.
